results.title: I keep getting stuck in an add loop won't let me back into game
results.content:
Be Patient with the Ad: The next time this happens, don't rush to close the ad. Look for a small "X" or ">>" button in the corner. Sometimes, these buttons only appear after a few seconds or a full minute. Tap it carefully to return to the game.

Clear the Game's Cache: This is a simple but effective fix.

Go to your phone's Settings > Apps.

Find the game that's giving you trouble and tap on it.

Tap on Storage & cache. [...] The "End Card" trap: Many modern ads have an "end card" that you have to interact with after the video ends. It might be a playable mini-game, a final image, and then a very small "X" or ">>" button. The ad won't close until you find and click this final button.

How to Fix It (Short-Term Solutions) [...] Why This Happens

Malicious or poorly coded ads: Some ad providers use aggressive tactics that force you to their app page in the Play Store. This is often an attempt to get you to download the app without your consent.

Game's ad integration bug: Sometimes, the way the game developers have integrated the ad service is buggy. The ad finishes, but the signal to return to the game doesn't work, so it defaults to opening the Play Store.
